sinopsis.es: Un monito despierta en un estudio donde todo parece inmóvil. Una selva que ve a lo lejos inspira al mono y a sus amigos a construir su propio bosque.
sinopsis.en: In a quiet stop-motion studio, a small monkey opens its eyes. Everything around it feels frozen. On a computer screen, a luminous jungle appears, distant, almost alive. With two companions, he sets out to create one of their own, using whatever they can find. A forest shaped by imagination, their only way out.
